p: Being chased by the fury of his enemies into a strange country, he was a dumb dove not seeking vengeance.
man would swallow me up: He shows that if God will help him, it must be now or never for all the world is against him and ready to devour him.
word: He stays his conscience on God's promise though he sees no present help.
words: All my counsels have evil success, and turn to my own sorrow.
They gather themselves together: As all the world against one man, and cannot be satisfied unless they have my life.
they escape by iniquity: They not only think to escape punishment, but the more wicked they are, the more impudent they grow.

tears into thy bottle: If God stores the tears of his saints, much more will he remember their blood, to avenge it: and though tyrants burn the bones, yet they cannot blot the tears and blood out of God's register.
Thy vows are upon me: Having received that which I required, I am bound to pay my vows of thanksgiving as I promised.
walk before God in the: As mindful of his great mercies, and giving thanks for the same.
light of the living: That is, in the life and light of the sun.
